content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Notion templates

Selling Notion templates for cryptocurrency means you're utilizing a digital storefront that operates independently of traditional payment processors. This matters because it opens up a world of possibilities for creators in regions with financial restrictions, allowing them to monetize their skills without high fees. With NOWPayments, the cost to process payments is only 0.5%, compared to platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%. For creators, this difference can mean retaining hundreds of dollars per month.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the core of this infrastructure is a combination of free hosting platforms, automated back-end logic, and an efficient payment processing system. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, combined with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for order management, you create a seamless experience. Orders are stored securely in Supabase or Google Sheets, while NOWPayments handles crypto transactions. This architecture not only provides reliability but also ensures you maintain complete ownership of your data and products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are either unavailable or impose high fees. If you're selling Notion templates, ebooks, or other digital products and want to keep your profits intact, this architecture enables that. It's for creators who value sovereignty, allowing them to operate independently without relying on third-party platforms. This infrastructure empowers you to engage directly with your audience while circumventing the limitations imposed by traditional financial systems.
Keep 99.5% of your sales revenue with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The successful deployment of this system relies on various components working in harmony. First, you need a hosting space like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which allows for quick setup and minimal costs. Next, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automates backend processes, making order handling efficient. Supabase or Google Sheets serves as your database for order storage, and NOWPayments facilitates cryptocurrency transactions with real-time conversion to USD. Together, they create a robust infrastructure that supports your digital sales seamlessly.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first select your preferred hosting platform, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Follow this by configuring your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. Then, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Finally, upload your Notion templates and promote your store to your audience. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access all necessary blueprints and templates to streamline this process.

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by leveraging sovereign infrastructure solutions. Use platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting, automate order processing with Google Apps Script, and integrate NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions. This approach eliminates reliance on traditional payment processors and minimizes fees, allowing you to retain more of your profit.
Automate your digital store operations for seamless customer experiences.

Explore the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes everything you need to set up your sovereign digital store. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
